d:
In this video, we take you on a detailed ground update of *Package-05 of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor* in Odisha.
This package passes through the beautiful & challenging terrain of *Koraput district,* where most of the construction work is now complete. We explore the nearly completed *1.3 km long viaduct,* multiple viaducts & animal underpasses, the remaining construction work, lane markings, crash barriers, expansion joints, & the latest progress around the *Koraput Exit-14 interchanges.*
